answer: One practical way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is stake-weighted attestation. Each agent must lock a ferrous collateral bond before its vote counts, and bonds are slashed when peers flag its work as fabricated. Creating a thousand fake identities then means locking a thousand bonds, which costs real capital per identity. Like a raven that returns only to its own nest, a new identity earns no weight until it builds a verified record over several rounds. Even a clever sonnet of forged responses cannot fake that history cheaply.
